base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Digital Nexus. Eclipse Data Dragons in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.name: Awakened Eclipse Data Dragon
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Digital — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Digital Nexus. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: Eclipse Data Dragon
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Eclipse Data Dragon bears the aesthetic of Digital Nexus — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Digital crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Digital Nexus. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Branded Eclipse Data Dragon
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Digital Nexus-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Overclock Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Digital Nexus, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Eclipse Data Dragon — Overclock Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Overclock path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Overclock Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Eclipse Data Dragon is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Digital Nexus. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

star_6.name: Eclipse Data Dragon the True
star_6.appearance: Eclipse Data Dragon now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Eclipse Data Dragons have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + Kernel Override Module

tamer_note: Digital tamers are called Operators. Bond is formed through shared missions — the monster must complete a task with you before acknowledging the link.

base_chain.name: Hatchling Binary Goblin Junior
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Binary Goblin Junior. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Digital Nexus. Binary Goblin Juniors in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.name: Stirring Binary Goblin Junior
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Digital — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Digital Nexus. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.name: Binary Goblin Junior
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Binary Goblin Junior bears the aesthetic of Digital Nexus — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Digital crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Digital Nexus. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

base_chain.name: Marked Binary Goblin Junior
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Digital Nexus-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Overclock Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Digital Nexus, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Binary Goblin Junior — Overclock Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Overclock path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Overclock Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Binary Goblin Junior is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Digital Nexus. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

star_6.name: Binary Goblin Junior the Undying
star_6.appearance: Binary Goblin Junior now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Binary Goblin Juniors have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + Kernel Override Module

star_7.appearance: The final form. Binary Goblin Junior stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.

tamer_note: Digital tamers are called Operators. Bond is formed through shared missions — the monster must complete a task with you before acknowledging the link.

base_chain.name: Bud Bleached Ransomware Knight II
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Bleached Ransomware Knight II. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Digital Nexus. Bleached Ransomware Knight IIs in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

base_chain.name: Kindling Bleached Ransomware Knight II
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Digital — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Digital Nexus. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: Bleached Ransomware Knight II
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Bleached Ransomware Knight II bears the aesthetic of Digital Nexus — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Digital crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Digital Nexus. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Branded Bleached Ransomware Knight II
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Digital Nexus-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Overclock Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Digital Nexus, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Bleached Ransomware Knight II — Overclock Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Overclock path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Overclock Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Bleached Ransomware Knight II is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Digital Nexus. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

star_6.name: Bleached Ransomware Knight II of the Apex
star_6.appearance: Bleached Ransomware Knight II now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Bleached Ransomware Knight IIs have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + Kernel Override Module

star_7.name: Myth Bleached Ransomware Knight II

star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.

base_chain.name: Pup Crimson Net Warrior

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Digital Nexus. Crimson Net Warriors in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.

base_chain.name: Emerging Crimson Net Warrior

lore_summary: A creature of the Digital Nexus, aligned with Digital energy. Known among tamers as a Unnamed Terror-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Digital Nexus. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Digital tamers are called Operators. Bond is formed through shared missions — the monster must complete a task with you before acknowledging the link.

base_chain.name: Fledgling Immortal MaloMyotismon
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Immortal MaloMyotismon. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Digital Nexus. Immortal MaloMyotismons in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.name: Rising Immortal MaloMyotismon
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Digital — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Digital Nexus. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Immortal MaloMyotismon
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Immortal MaloMyotismon bears the aesthetic of Digital Nexus — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Digital crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Digital Nexus. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

base_chain.name: Exalted Immortal MaloMyotismon
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Digital Nexus-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Overclock Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Digital Nexus, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.

base_chain.name: Fledgling Code Shard Corrupted
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Code Shard Corrupted. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Digital Nexus. Code Shard Corrupteds in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: Rising Code Shard Corrupted

base_chain.name: Bud Dire Trojan Fragment Ancient
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Dire Trojan Fragment Ancient. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Digital Nexus. Dire Trojan Fragment Ancients in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.

base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Overclock Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Digital Nexus, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.appearance: The Overclock path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Overclock Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Craven Pixel Warrior is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Digital Nexus. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

star_6.name: Craven Pixel Warrior Incarnate
star_6.appearance: Craven Pixel Warrior now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Craven Pixel Warriors have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + Kernel Override Module

base_chain.name: Spawn Overlord Grand Digimon
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Overlord Grand Digimon. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Digital Nexus. Overlord Grand Digimons in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Emerging Overlord Grand Digimon
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Digital — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Digital Nexus. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Digital Nexus. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Dim Error Sprite Ancient

base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Digital Nexus. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.name: Chosen Error Sprite Ancient
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Digital Nexus-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Overclock Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Digital Nexus, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_6.name: Error Sprite Ancient the Last

base_chain.name: Seed Binary Warrior III

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Digital Nexus. Binary Warrior IIIs in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.

base_chain.name: Emerging Binary Warrior III

base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Digital Nexus. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: Wisp Chaos Cyber Samurai

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Digital Nexus. Chaos Cyber Samurais in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.

lore_summary: A creature of the Digital Nexus, aligned with Digital energy. Known among tamers as a Arachnid-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Digital Nexus. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Digital tamers are called Operators. Bond is formed through shared missions — the monster must complete a task with you before acknowledging the link.

base_chain.name: Bud Tattered Data Crawler I
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Tattered Data Crawler I. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Digital Nexus. Tattered Data Crawler Is in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Awakened Tattered Data Crawler I
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Digital — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Digital Nexus. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: Tattered Data Crawler I
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Tattered Data Crawler I bears the aesthetic of Digital Nexus — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Digital crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Digital Nexus. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

base_chain.name: Branded Tattered Data Crawler I
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Digital Nexus-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Overclock Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Digital Nexus, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster
